name: cc-tiers
description: Quality-first tiers for Pro and Max: Opus plans and reviews, Sonnet researches and builds, Haiku does the small stuff, with an effort ladder, independent review, and a quality benchmark

max_attempts.title: Max attempts per tier
max_attempts.description: How many failures a task may have at one tier before it escalates (Haiku to Sonnet to Opus). A failure is a failed test, a rejected review, or a subagent error. Default 2.

review_policy.title: Review policy
review_policy.description: risky (default): Opus reviews risky or non-trivial work and skips a trivial Haiku pass. cheap: Sonnet reviews Haiku output, and Opus reviews only risky or non-trivial work. always: review every pass, Haiku on Sonnet and the rest on Opus. never: no review pass.

learn.title: Learn from Haiku failures
learn.description: When on, a task similar to one that already failed on Haiku starts on Sonnet. The record is .claude/cc-tiers-history.json, gitignored when it is first written. off writes nothing and leaves routing alone.

budget_5h.title: 5h conserve threshold
budget_5h.description: When the 5-hour usage window reaches this percent, new work stays on Haiku or Sonnet. Opus remains for the escalation ceiling and critical review. Default 80.

budget_7d.title: 7d conserve threshold
budget_7d.description: When the 7-day usage window reaches this percent, routing conserves the same way as the 5-hour threshold. Default 80.

trivial_extra.title: Extra Haiku phrases
trivial_extra.description: Comma-separated phrases that also count as trivial Haiku work, added to the built-in list. Example: changelog edits, license year bumps.

risky_extra.title: Extra review phrases
risky_extra.description: Comma-separated phrases that also require an Opus review, added to the built-in risky phrases. Built-in keywords already cover auth, payments, migrations, schemas, security, and concurrency. Example: terraform, billing.

effort_ladder.title: Effort ladder
effort_ladder.description: on: a retry at the same tier runs one effort level higher before the task changes model (Haiku low to medium, Sonnet high to xhigh, Opus high to xhigh), and cc-tiers sets that effort on the Agent call. off: each agent keeps the effort its file pins.

classifier.title: Haiku classifier
classifier.description: haiku: before a cc-tiers:worker call runs, a quick Haiku pass checks that the task is really trivial and sends it to Sonnet when it is not. local: only the keyword lists and the complexity score decide; the orchestrator marks worker prompts CC_TIERS_CLASSIFY: skip.

show_cost.title: Show cost
show_cost.description: on: each finished task and the session summary show an estimated cost at Anthropic API list prices, and what the same tokens would cost at Opus rates. Subscription plans are not billed this way; read it as a comparison. off (default): no cost lines.

light_path.title: Light path
light_path.description: inline: when a request is one trivial task, the session agent does it itself, with no subagent and no checker; that is cheaper than a fresh worker context. delegate: skip the plan and send it to the worker in one call. off: every request is planned the usual way.

research.title: Research gate
research.description: on (default): before code goes to cc-tiers:implementer or cc-tiers:architect, cc-tiers:researcher must report pass for that task and the prompt must say CC_TIERS_RESEARCH: done, or the prompt must say CC_TIERS_RESEARCH: none - <reason>. Otherwise cc-tiers refuses the call. off: no research step is required.

specify.title: Spec gate
specify.description: on (default): before code goes to cc-tiers:implementer or cc-tiers:architect, the prompt must carry acceptance criteria between CC_TIERS_SPEC_BEGIN and CC_TIERS_SPEC_END lines, or say CC_TIERS_SPEC: none - <reason>. Otherwise cc-tiers refuses the call. off: no written criteria are required.
